[tp-asciidoc-viewer%allow-script,label="tp-skeleton"]
========
[script,type="tp/asciidoc"]
----
.Basic usage
======
[tp-skeleton,label="Article layout preview"]
=====
[script,type="tp/html"]
====
<main>
  <nav>Home · Articles · About</nav>
  <h1>Building accessible interfaces</h1>
  <p>An introduction to the article.</p>
  <figure><img src="portrait.jpg" alt="Portrait"><figcaption>Caption</figcaption></figure>
  <h2>Key ideas</h2>
  <ul><li>Clear structure</li><li>Consistent interactions</li></ul>
  <table><tr><th>Feature</th><th>Status</th></tr><tr><td>Keyboard</td><td>Ready</td></tr></table>
  <blockquote>A useful quotation.</blockquote>
</main>
====
=====
======

.Javascript API
======
[script,type="module"]
====
import "/components/skeleton/skeleton.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-skeleton");
element1.setAttribute("label", "Article layout preview");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("script");
element2.setAttribute("type", "tp/html");
element2.textContent = "\n    \u003cmain>\n      \u003cnav>Home · Articles · About\u003c/nav>\n      \u003ch1>Building accessible interfaces\u003c/h1>\n      \u003cp>An introduction to the article.\u003c/p>\n      \u003cfigure>\u003cimg src=\"portrait.jpg\" alt=\"Portrait\">\u003cfigcaption>Caption\u003c/figcaption>\u003c/figure>\n      \u003ch2>Key ideas\u003c/h2>\n      \u003cul>\u003cli>Clear structure\u003c/li>\u003cli>Consistent interactions\u003c/li>\u003c/ul>\n      \u003ctable>\u003ctr>\u003cth>Feature\u003c/th>\u003cth>Status\u003c/th>\u003c/tr>\u003ctr>\u003ctd>Keyboard\u003c/td>\u003ctd>Ready\u003c/td>\u003c/tr>\u003c/table>\n      \u003cblockquote>A useful quotation.\u003c/blockquote>\n    \u003c/main>\n  ";
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
